summary: [spec fidelity + standards] put() cannot heal a .zst the HEAD already calls Altered when a valid plain object of the same digest exists. Probed on live MinIO: .zst cut to 200000 bytes (canon-stored-size 305766) beside a valid plain object: gate check exits 1 (stored blob ... .zst: object holds 200000 bytes, recorded 305766), then `canon artifacts store` says 'stored 0, already stored 1' and writes nothing, gate stays 1; the verify hint tells the operator to run exactly that command. put skips on probe_raw == Present even when probe_zst is Altered (brief F1 'already there' rule counts a plain object of the same size, and its failure-mode paragraph admits only the HEAD-misses case, not this HEAD-detects case). Needs a 0.39 canon re-uploading a plain object beside a damaged .zst, so rare. Fix: skip on the plain object only when no .zst exists or the .zst probe is not Altered. Blast radius: the same short-circuit serves move (AlreadyStored, then observe(full) gives ARTIFACTS_BLOB_CORRUPT naming the .zst, so move is not silently stuck) and the evidence/review upload path.
